Bloomberg.t: Asia Stocks Erase Early Losses as AI Worries Subside
Bloomberg.s: Asian stocks recovered almost all early losses Wednesday as concerns surrounding the global artificial intelligence trade eased.

Bloomberg.t: US Stock Futures Rebound as Election Uncertainty Evaporates
Bloomberg.tt: ABD Hisse Senedi Endeksi Vadeli İşlemleri Demokratların Süpürgesi Arasında Erken Kayıplarını Karşıladı
Bloomberg.s: US equity index futures rallied, reversing earlier losses, after the Democrats swept to power in Congress and President Donald Trump said he would accept the results, easing uncertainty and prompting investors to buy the recent dip in stocks.
Bloomberg.ss: ABD hisse senedi endeks vadeli işlemleri, yatırımcıların ara seçim sonuçlarını sindirmesi ve Demokratların ABD Kongresi'nin her iki meclisinin de kontrolünü kazanmasıyla kayıplarını azalttı.

Bloomberg.t: European Stocks Rise After Midterms as Renewables and Banks Jump
Bloomberg.s: European stocks extended gains after Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress in the US midterms, with renewables and banks outperforming.

Bloomberg.t: Musk’s Tesla, SpaceX Slide as Democrats Sweep Congress
Bloomberg.s: Shares of Elon Musk’s Tesla Inc. and Space Exploration Technologies Corp. fell ahead of Wednesday’s US stock-market opening as Democrats swept to control of Congress, sharpening investor concern over the future of the Republican megadonor’s key holdings.

Bloomberg.t: India’s Consumer Spending Boom Comes With Growing Debt Bill
Bloomberg.s: When 25-year-old restaurant worker Navjot Singh wanted an iPhone he couldn’t afford on his monthly salary of 50,000 Indian rupees ($521), taking out a small loan made the purchase possible. A PlayStation and television set followed, along with loans for a wine and spirits course and a trip home.

Bloomberg.t: Stocks, Bonds Rally After US Vote as Dollar Falls: Markets Wrap
Bloomberg.s: A Democratic sweep of Congress rippled across global markets, lifting stocks and Treasuries while sending the dollar lower as traders assessed what the results will mean for President Donald Trump’s agenda.

Bloomberg.t: Gold Surges Above $4,000 as Dollar, Yields Fall on Democrat Win
Bloomberg.s: Gold surged above $4,000 an ounce as the dollar and Treasury yields fell after Democrats swept the US midterm election, a result that could constrain President Donald Trump’s fiscal agenda.

Bloomberg.t: Dollar Dips Most in Two Months as US Vote Spurs Policy Risks
Bloomberg.s: The dollar sank the most in two months as Democrats’ sweeping midterm elections win fueled concern about political gridlock and tougher tech regulation that could damp foreign demand for US assets.

Bloomberg.t: Singapore Stocks Claw Back Losses as Regional Mood Improves
Bloomberg.s: Singapore’s equity benchmark Straits Times Index advanced in late trading, after briefly entering a technical correction, as broader sentiment improved even as heavyweight bank shares slide.

Bloomberg.t: Global Renewable Stocks Surge After Democrats Sweep Congress
Bloomberg.s: Renewable energy stocks rallied around the world after the Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress in the US midterm elections, an outcome seen as supporting more favorable policy for the industry.

CNBC.ss: Hazine getirileri Salı gecesi, yatırımcıların ABD ara seçimlerinde Demokratların kazandığı büyük zaferlerin yol açtığı hisse senedi vadeli kontratlarındaki satışlardan korunmak için sığınma aramasıyla düştü.
